structural_findings.facility: 慶友整形外科クリニック
structural_findings.issue: Three staged facility identities share the same current physical facility/address; denominator/core deduplication should be audited before changing facility_universe.

policy: Exact manufacturer-locator name is insufficient when address/contact metadata conflicts with current authoritative facility information.
Institution-level university locator labels are not assigned to a specific affiliated hospital without facility-level evidence.
Branch-specific manufacturer assignment requires branch-specific evidence.
Facility-universe deduplication findings are recorded separately and do not mutate the 949 denominator until core audit is complete.
